starter-build.caption: Example build
rows: Any magnetic or stick-on arrow rest
Shibuya DX Gold Tip: worth buying from the start. Reliable, tunable, and many archers keep it for years
Avalon Classic Carbon, or an equivalent sight
8 Easton XX75 Platinum Plus aluminium, made to your length in the shop
Tab with an adjustable ledge, fitted to your hand in the shop
Finger sling: a flat shoelace usually works better than a shop-bought sling
Your choice: research what fits your budget. Avalon Classic is a good starting point

mid-limbs.caption: Better: buy once your draw weight is stable. Budget: buy while it is still going up.

mid-upgrades.caption: Upgrades in the order most archers need them
rows: When your form is reasonably consistent
As your draw weight goes up
Extender, V-bar and two side rods that match your long rod
When you're ready to step up in draw weight
Budget limbs at your new weight
As you improve your limbs and start shooting longer distances
Cheap aluminium-carbon arrows, such as Merlin Alimax or Pandarus CA320, spined for your new draw weight
Only if you started on an entry riser

starter-risers.caption: Recommended: intermediate risers. Entry: cheaper alternatives. Wildcard: suits both Olympic recurve and barebow.
